71: - **Bathing**: Sending the blob to the bathtub completes the bath/wash quests (`mq_bor2` / `mq_ang3`).
72: - **Bench**: Sitting on the garden bench completes the outdoor relaxation quest (`mq_hap3`).

74: - **Decorating**: Using furniture in the bag completes the decorating quest (`mq_clm2`).
